sentence: This project studies which genes and proteins let sperm and egg recognize, stick to, and fuse with each other during fertilization.
This project studies how mast cells cause asthma and psoriasis, using animal models that carry the human version of a mast cell receptor.
This project develops imaging technology to study cardiovascular disease and to turn basic research into clinical success.
This project builds microscopy techniques that map the three-dimensional structure of cells and tissues and the variation in molecular expression, such as in tumors.
This project studies how activity in one region of the hippocampus supports social memory and the forming of social attachments.
This project tries to find out how two chemical changes to the heart protein myosin binding protein-C affect relaxation of the diabetic heart.
This project tests whether a natural immune-boosting stimulant can help bone marrow recover after radiation exposure, with or without traumatic injury.
This project studies people who lack working copies of certain genes, using clinical exams and genetic data to learn about heart failure and stroke.
This project studies genes linked to non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, using human liver tissue engineered in the laboratory.
This project follows older adults in a community to find risk factors and blood markers that predict cognitive decline and dementia.
This project tests gene-editing therapies in mouse models of Huntington's disease and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
This project studies how a type of cell in Drosophila combines sensory information with motor plans to guide movement.
This project studies how the gene Leiomodin1 works and is controlled, and why mice lacking it develop coronary artery disease.
This project studies the structure and function of two enzymes from Mycobacterium tuberculosis and how they can be blocked.
This project develops a way to image tiny human tumors grown outside the body, using radiotracers that are already used in clinics.
This project builds devices that combine 3D bioprinting and opto-neurotechnology to model the brain and retina on a chip.
This project builds accelerated fatigue and biofilm tests that predict how dental restorative materials perform in patients.
This project tests whether microbial factors can guide medication choices and gut healing in children with Crohn's disease.
This project uses machine learning methods to find a personalized way to prevent persistent acute kidney injury after cardiac surgery.
This project studies what makes the heart lose its ability to regenerate as it grows after birth.
